aboutIntro.title: A little about how I build.
aboutIntro.bio: I'm Amr Mohamed, a frontend developer based in Cairo, Egypt. I have 3+ years of experience building Vue.js and Nuxt.js applications, from customer-facing websites and e-commerce storefronts to admin dashboards. I focus on maintainable interfaces, reusable components, API integration, and accessible Arabic/English experiences.

marcaStore.intro: Built the full frontend for a two-market e-commerce business across Egypt and Saudi Arabia. Delivered a customer-facing storefront alongside a comprehensive admin portal connected to Firebase for real-time inventory, order processing, and customer management.

0.title: Storefront Home
0.caption: Customer Interface
0.stageDescription: Product catalog, category filters, cart, and bilingual Arabic/English checkout flow.

1.title: Admin Dashboard
1.caption: Orders & Products
1.stageDescription: Complete order fulfillment lifecycle, inventory tracking, and Firebase authentication.

2.title: Role Permissions
2.caption: Admin/Employee/Merchant
2.stageDescription: Role-based dashboards restricting sensitive product manipulation for Admin, Employee, and Merchant.

3.title: Arabic RTL Layout
3.caption: vue-i18n Alignment
3.stageTitle: Marca Store — Arabic RTL Localization Layout
3.stageDescription: Pixel-perfect right-to-left UI mirroring using vue-i18n and localized VeeValidate forms.

0.title: Dual-Application Frontend Architecture
0.text: Architected two separate web clients from scratch using Vue.js and Vite: a customer shopping interface and an internal business admin portal.

1.title: 46 Modular Components & 21 Pinia Stores
1.text: Standardized UI elements across catalog cards, modals, checkout inputs, and dynamic charts with modular Pinia state management for cart, wishlist, auth, and order flow.

2.title: Three-Tier Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
2.text: Enforced granular permissions for Admin, Employee, and Merchant accounts within the management backoffice, restricting product manipulation and order approvals.

3.title: Bilingual Localization & Full RTL Support
3.text: Integrated vue-i18n for English and Arabic with automated right-to-left layout switching, mirrored navigation, and localized validation rules with VeeValidate.
